hero.headline: Precision Valves & Flow Control. Zero Leakage. Micron Tolerance.
hero.leadParagraph: Jasvi Industries manufactures micron-precision instrumentation needle valves, manifold blocks, ball valves, and flow control systems rated up to 10,000 PSI for global aerospace, chemical, cryogenic, and energy partners.

marquee: NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 Sour Gas Compliant

valveProducts.title: High-Pressure Forged Needle Valve (6,000 / 10,000 PSI)
valveProducts.meta: One-piece forged body with non-rotating stem tip and packing below thread design for hazardous high-pressure isolation.

valveProducts.title: 5-Way Differential Pressure Valve Manifold
valveProducts.meta: Compact direct-mount valve manifold integrating two block valves, one equalizer valve, and two vent valves for differential pressure transmitters.

valveProducts.title: 3-Piece High-Pressure Trunnion Ball Valve
valveProducts.meta: Full-bore 3-piece bolted body design with micro-lapped spherical ball, blow-out proof stem, and spring-energized seats.

valveProducts.title: Dual-Plate Wafer Check Valve
valveProducts.meta: Compact resilient-seated check valve with spring-loaded dual plates preventing pressure surges and water hammer in industrial piping.

valveProducts.title: Double Block & Bleed (DBB) Monoflange Valve
valveProducts.meta: Integrated primary isolate, vent, and secondary isolate in a single forged compact body replacing traditional bulky piping manifolds.

valveProducts.title: 2-Way Block & Bleed Gauge Manifold
valveProducts.meta: Designed for pressure gauges, pressure switches, and absolute pressure transmitters with isolate and calibration vent ports.

machinerySection.title: Precision Machining & Valve Test Workstations
machinerySection.subtitle: Swipe or drag through our climate-controlled 5-axis CNC machining centers, automated hydrostatic test benches, and Zeiss 3D CMM metrology suites.

machinery.title: 5-Axis VMC Valve Body Milling
machinery.description: Solid forging billet machining for complex multi-port valve bodies and manifold blocks in a single clamping setup.

machinery.title: CNC Precision Ball & Stem Turning
machinery.description: Twin-spindle CNC turning centers generating sub-micron spherical balls, valve stems, and gland packing seats.

machinery.title: 10,000 PSI Automated Hydro Test Rig
machinery.description: Digital hydrostatic shell test, high-pressure nitrogen seat leak test, and helium sniffer test conforming to API 598.

machinery.title: Zeiss 3D CNC CMM Quality Lab
machinery.description: Temperature-controlled Clean Room metrology with laser line probes and Renishaw 5-axis scanning heads.

processSection.title: 4-Stage Valve Manufacturing & Testing Benchmark
processSection.subtitle: Every valve undergoes 100% material authentication, micron CNC machining, and automated pressure hold before dispatch.

process.title: Spectro & PMI Ingestion
process.description: 100% Positive Material Identification (PMI) and optical emission spectro analysis on forged billets to verify chemical composition.

process.title: 5-Axis CNC Precision
process.description: Single-setup continuous 5-axis milling and micro-honing guaranteeing seat squareness and mirror-finished spherical balls.

process.title: API 598 Hydro & Gas Testing
process.description: 1.5x working pressure hydrostatic shell hold test followed by high-pressure bubble-tight nitrogen seat leakage verification.

process.title: CMM & EN 10204 3.1 MTC
process.description: Digital coordinate measuring machine dimensional sign-off, laser serial marking, and full material test certificate issuance.
